tasks.subject: Task 1: Offline summary generator (story 9)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure `Summary.Generate(BusinessRecord)` that returns a short, deterministic, plain-language summary, with distinct phrasing for Active vs Cancelled and GST status.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/Core/Summary.cs`
- Test: `tests/SummaryTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Active record → text contains "currently active" and "registered for GST".
- Cancelled record → text contains "cancelled", "may no longer be trading", and "not registered for GST".
- Every fixture record → non-empty text containing the entity name.

**Verify:** `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~SummaryTests"` → all pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["teams/team-1-abr/src/Core/Summary.cs", "teams/team-1-abr/tests/SummaryTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~SummaryTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Active record text contains 'currently active' and 'registered for GST'", "Cancelled record text contains 'cancelled', 'may no longer be trading', 'not registered for GST'", "Every fixture record produces non-empty text containing the entity name"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Browse/filter query methods (story 7)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `AllRecords`, `FilterByState`, and `DistinctStates` to `Lookup` so the UI can browse and filter the sample dataset by state.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/Core/Lookup.cs`
- Test: `tests/LookupBrowseTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `FilterByState("VIC")` returns only VIC records; `FilterByState(null)`, `""`, and `"All"` return all records.
- `FilterByState` matches state case-insensitively (`"vic"` matches `"VIC"`).
- `DistinctStates()` returns the sorted unique set `["ACT", "NSW", "QLD", "VIC"]`.

**Verify:** `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~LookupBrowseTests"` → all pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["teams/team-1-abr/src/Core/Lookup.cs", "teams/team-1-abr/tests/LookupBrowseTests.cs"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet test --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~LookupBrowseTests\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["FilterByState('VIC') returns only VIC records; null/''/'All' return all", "FilterByState is case-insensitive", "DistinctStates() returns sorted unique [ACT, NSW, QLD, VIC]"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Summary + empty + loading UI (stories 8-9)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Show the generated summary in the result card, show pre-search instructions when idle, and show an accessible loading indicator during a brief simulated delay without shifting layout.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/Web/Lookup.cs` (AbnLookup code-behind)
- Modify: `src/Web/Components/AbnLookup.razor`
- Modify: `src/Web/wwwroot/styles.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Before any search, the results region shows brief guidance including the example ABN.
- Submitting shows a "Searching…" indicator (with `aria-busy="true"`) and disables the Search button while loading.
- A found result shows a "Summary" block with the generated text and an "Automatically generated…" note, inside the existing `aria-live` region.
- The app builds and existing tests still pass.

**Verify:** `dotnet build` → succeeds; `dotnet test` → all pass. Manual: run the Web project, search `51824753556`, observe brief "Searching…" then result with summary; reload and observe idle instructions.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/Lookup.cs", "teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/Components/AbnLookup.razor", "teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/wwwroot/styles.css"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet build teams/team-1-abr/team-1-abr.sln && dotnet test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Idle results region shows guidance including example ABN", "Submitting shows aria-busy loading indicator and disables Search", "Found result shows Summary block with generated text and note inside aria-live region", "Build and existing tests pass"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Accessible browse & state filter (story 7)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a `BusinessBrowser` component that lists all sample businesses with an accessible state dropdown filter and an announced result count, and compose it into the page.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/Web/Components/BusinessBrowser.razor`
- Modify: `src/Web/App.razor`
- Modify: `src/Web/wwwroot/styles.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The page shows a "Browse businesses" section listing all four records.
- Choosing a state from the labelled dropdown narrows the list to matching records.
- The result count is announced via an `aria-live` region and status is shown as text (not colour alone).
- The app builds and all tests still pass.

**Verify:** `dotnet build` → succeeds. Manual: run the Web project, tab to the state dropdown, choose "VIC", confirm the list narrows to the VIC record and the count text updates.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/Components/BusinessBrowser.razor", "teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/App.razor", "teams/team-1-abr/src/Web/wwwroot/styles.css"], "verifyCommand": "dotnet build teams/team-1-abr/team-1-abr.sln && dotnet test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Browse businesses section lists all four records", "Choosing a state narrows the list via the labelled dropdown", "Result count announced via aria-live; status shown as text not colour alone", "Build and all tests pass"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
